name: cú síth

attributes.attribute: the fairy dog of the Highlands
dark green and the size of a small bull
always moved in a straight line

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The cú síth is a Scottish mythological being. It is the fairy dog of the Highlands. Other fairy creatures were black or red with white ears, but the cú síth was not. It was dark green and stood as tall as a small bull. The dog left enormous footprints, each the size of a large man's foot. Each journey held to one straight line. It crossed the world seeking prey and would chase other dogs too.

okr.objective: The cú síth is a dark green fairy dog of the Scottish Highlands.
key_results: The cú síth is a Scottish mythological being, the fairy dog of the Highlands.
It was dark green and stood the size of a small bull.
It left footprints the size of a large man's foot.
It moved in a straight line and hunted prey, including other dogs.
